item.title: Tecnologo: Sustainable platform for the development and scalability of starter cultures (FERMHUB) - ERDF 2021-2027, EFRE1150 (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-04 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-08 Microbiologia agraria, alimentare e ambientale

Support for innovative fermentation processes aimed at valorizing and recycling food by-products, using alternative raw materials, and developing products and processes with high nutritional value. Activities include the selection of starter cultures based on their metabolic and technological properties, microbiome modelling, and the optimization of fermentation protocols. item.title: Tecnologo: NEXT-G FIS-2023-02552 CUP I53C24003120001 “How new genes emerge: exploring a model of novel gene creation following the evolution of wheat” (Univ. PISA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 13:00
Institution: Univ. PISA, Pisa
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-06 Genetica, chimica e pedologia agraria e forestale

The NEXT-G project explores how transposons, DNA elements capable of rapidly reorganizing genomes, contribute to the creation of new genes in wheat through the process of exaptation. By applying bioinformatic and genomic approaches, it investigates the evolutionary impact of transposons on the creation of new genes and the mechanisms that drive this process. Focusing on wheat, the project offers new perspectives on the evolution of plant genomes and on adaptation to selective pressures, with particular attention to the early stages of domestication.
